name: vCardigit
author: TechinMedia

sections.description:
Give someone you meet a quick way to keep in touch. They can scan the QR code on your printed business card, open your profile on your own website, and tap Save to Contacts to download a vCard (.vcf) for their address book.

Create your first card

Add a portrait, company logo, job title, phone numbers, email addresses and the links you want to share. Choose Simple, Classic or Mint Minimal and open the public profile to see how it looks on a phone. You can create unlimited cards in the Free edition and manage them in WordPress.

Share it in print and on your site

  • Choose Static vCard QR (Direct Save) for an offline contact code. Scan it and confirm the contact on the phone. Print a new code when the encoded details change. Existing cards keep their profile-link QR.
  • Download a card’s PNG QR code for a name badge, business card or event handout.
  • Update a job title or phone number in WordPress. The same printed QR code leads to the updated profile as long as you keep the card, domain and profile address in place.
  • Embed the card on a team page with [vcard id="12"], or show just its QR code with [vcard_qr id="12"]. Replace 12 with the card’s ID, or copy the shortcode from your card list.

Try a live card or follow the illustrated setup guide.

For teams using Premium

The separately installed Premium edition adds 27 designs for a total of 30, QR colors and logos, SVG export, and bulk QR downloads. Organize cards by department or branch, capture inquiries through a card’s lead form, and see which profiles and links visitors use.

External services and privacy

Local fonts and charts

Profile fonts are distributed locally under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, with complete per-family notices and immutable source references in assets/fonts/manifest.json. Premium analytics uses the locally bundled Chart.js 4.4.1 MIT-licensed browser bundle. Neither feature contacts a font or chart CDN.

Freemius (optional account connection; Premium purchases and licensing)

The bundled Freemius SDK provides account connection, purchases, licence management and Premium updates through freemius.com services, including api.freemius.com. Free card features do not require a paid licence; the Free connection screen provides a skip option. Connecting an account or activating a licence sends the account identity and site/licence information needed for that operation. Depending on the permissions displayed by the SDK, this can include the administrator’s name and email, site URL/title/language, WordPress/PHP/plugin/SDK versions, activation status and plugin/theme inventory. Review the connection screen and its permission controls before proceeding. Licence and update checks contact the service for connected Premium installations. Freemius handles purchase and billing information. Read the Freemius Terms of Service and Freemius Privacy Policy on the providerâ€™s site. For details about the optional connection, permissions and Premium licensing in this plugin, see how vCardigit uses Freemius.

Integrations in the separately distributed Premium edition

These integrations are not included in the WordPress.org Free feature set:

  • Cloudflare Turnstile: when a site operator configures Turnstile for lead capture, the browser loads challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js and Cloudflare processes browser/network signals for bot detection. The site sends the submitted verification token and its configured secret to Cloudflare’s HTTPS Siteverify endpoint. See Turnstile documentation, Cloudflare’s terms and Turnstile privacy addendum.
  • Notifications and webhooks: enabled lead notifications send submitted details through the site’s WordPress mail transport to configured recipients. If a webhook URL is configured, lead data is forwarded to that endpoint. The operator selects the destination and is responsible for its access controls, terms and privacy notice; no Zapier, Make or HubSpot account is connected automatically.

Profile links, social links, maps and contact actions can open destinations configured by the card owner when clicked. Those destinations have their own terms and privacy practices.

Source and third-party notices

The plugin’s PHP, JavaScript and CSS are included in the package. Third-party components retain their bundled licence files. LICENSE.txt, COPYING-GPL3.txt and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt provide the applicable licence texts, component attributions and source links. The Freemius SDK is version 2.13.5: SDK source. Its compiled pricing application is developed in Freemius/pricing-page; that repository documents the source and npm install / npm run build workflow. The bundled pricing application’s third-party notices are also retained in vendor/freemius/assets/js/pricing/freemius-pricing.js.LICENSE.txt.

The three Free theme previews use fictional demonstration profiles and AI-generated portraits. Their illustrative QR codes open the vCardigit product page at https://techinmedia.net/vcardigit/, not a customer profile. The directory screenshots show the Free edition’s actual screens and a fictional public profile.

The Statistics, Leads, Departments and Bulk Import menu pages in Free introduce the separately distributed Premium edition using locally bundled screenshots. They are labelled Sample Data / Illustrative Preview and contain fictional profiles and enquiries, not your site’s activity. These images do not enable Premium features or send tracking requests. Leads supports enquiry management and configured notifications; CSV performance export belongs to Statistics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vcardigit folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Public /v/{slug} profile and VCF links require WordPress pretty permalinks and working web-server rewrite rules. On a new site, choose a non-Plain structure in Settings â†’ Permalinks (for example, Post name) and save. On an existing site, retain its established non-Plain structure; do not change published URLs just to install the plugin.
  4. Go to vCardigit in the admin sidebar and create your first card. The optional Freemius account connection can be skipped.
  5. Open the profile URL and test Save to Contacts before sharing or printing the QR code. The default Plain permalink setup does not serve these pretty profile links.

Upgrading from the 2.8.8 Free edition? Deactivate the old plugin on the Plugins screen and activate vCardigit Free. Network administrators can do this from Network Admin for network-active installations. Keep the same site and profile URL prefix to preserve printed QR links.

If you purchased Premium, download its ZIP from your Freemius customer portal. In WordPress, open Plugins â†’ Add New Plugin â†’ Upload Plugin, select the ZIP and install it. On the Plugins screen, deactivate the Free edition and activate Premium. Your vCardigit cards and settings are retained when you deactivate Free.
sections.faq:
Where is my data stored?

Card records are stored in your WordPress database, in a custom table named {prefix}_vcardigit_contacts. Images and generated QR files use your WordPress media/uploads storage. Profile fonts are bundled locally. Optional Freemius account and licensing workflows use external services; the separately distributed Premium edition adds integrations described below. See External services and privacy for the conditions and data involved.

What happens to my cards if I uninstall the plugin?

Deactivation and removal preserve cards, leads, analytics, settings and QR media. Free/Premium replacement does not erase Premium data. An explicit data-removal workflow is not included in this release.

Will my QR codes still work after a WordPress update?

Profile URLs use a rewrite rule registered on plugin activation (/v/{slug}). Editing a card’s name preserves its existing slug. Keep the domain, hosting, WordPress installation and URL prefix available; changing the prefix can break previously printed QR links. Recheck profile links after a WordPress update or permalink change.

Can non-admin users manage cards?

Yes. The plugin registers a custom capability vcardigit_manage (assigned to administrators on activation). You can grant it to any role using a role-management plugin like Members or User Role Editor.

Is this GDPR/KVKK compliant?

The plugin does not provide a legal compliance guarantee. Public card details are visible to visitors. Fonts and chart assets are served locally, without Google Fonts or chart CDN requests. Premium analytics stores profile/click events and a salted IP-derived identifier. Premium lead capture validates the optional consent checkbox when enabled and stores submitted contact details and an IP-derived identifier; it does not store a separate consent record. Request limiting also uses short-lived IP-derived counters. Review the external services below, your WordPress/hosting logs, retention practices and any integrations before publishing your own privacy notice. Website operators are responsible for their lawful use of the plugin.

Does the free version have any limits?

No card limits, no time limits, no watermarks. The free version is fully functional. The separately installed Premium edition includes advanced themes, QR customization, analytics, departments and lead capture.
sections.changelog:
3.1.0

  • Added a Static vCard QR (Direct Save) option. Scanning it lets someone add your contact details offline. Existing cards keep their profile-link QR codes.
  • Added iPhone and Android import instructions below Save to Contacts in the Simple, Classic and Mint Minimal themes.
  • Fixed private notes appearing in public contact data. Private notes are excluded from public profiles, downloaded vCards and static QR codes.
  • Fixed the broken lock icon beside Download SVG and other Premium controls in the WordPress admin.

3.0.2

  • Free leaves plugin activation to WordPress and the site administrator when upgrading from version 2.8.8. Existing cards, QR files and contact downloads are preserved.

3.0.1

  • Keep existing cards, QR codes, vCard downloads and licence connections available after updating from version 2.8.8.

3.0.0

  • New vCardigit identity, keeping the existing three Free themes, Premium features and public profile/QR/VCF contracts.
  • Coordinated package, text domain, data and integration identifiers; controlled migration tooling retains existing cards and settings.

2.8.9

  • Separate Premium implementation from Free while preserving existing cards and settings.
  • Update php-qrcode to 5.0.5; retain PHP 8.1 support and settings-container 3.3.0.
  • Serve profile fonts and Premium charts locally with their licenses and source records.
  • Use WordPress asset APIs and strengthen request validation and explicit edition switching.
  • Preserve HTTPS/TLS protections, atomic QR publication, three Free themes and all 30 Premium themes.

2.8.8

  • Keep the targeted atomic QR replacement explanation attached to its call during package generation. QR, TLS and data behavior are unchanged.

2.8.7

  • Document four line-specific WordPress.org review exceptions for existing-handle TLS protection and atomic QR publication. Runtime behavior is unchanged.
  • Replace the SDK form helper with a readable GPL-compatible adapter written by Tech-in Media while preserving the checkout form interface.

2.8.6

  • Admin: introduce Premium Statistics, Leads, Departments and Bulk Import with clearly labelled, fictional sample screenshots on their existing Free menu pages.
  • Accessibility: provide responsive, keyboard-accessible full-size previews and a legible white logo on dark showcase headers.
  • Maintenance: preserve three Free themes, all 30 designs in Premium, existing licence checks, HTTPS protections, atomic QR writes and database schema 2.0.

2.8.5

  • Free: include Simple, Classic and Mint Minimal without a Premium licence.
  • Compatibility: retain the classic-pro and mint-minimal theme IDs and existing card data; no database migration.
  • Packaging: keep the remaining 27 theme designs Premium-only.

2.8.4

  • Fix: keep the locked-theme notice hidden when the selected theme is available.
  • Fix: use the existing Freemius upgrade URL in Settings instead of example links, with a safe text fallback.
  • Maintenance: retain the 2.8.3 security fixes, SDK 2.13.5 and database schema 2.0.

2.8.3

  • Security: verified HTTPS for Freemius licensing and protected update downloads, with SDK 2.13.5.
  • Compatibility: use WordPress asset, URL and file APIs; preserve atomic QR cache publication and stable profile links.
  • Security: validate live QR preview authorization and malformed input; prepare bulk lead identifiers.
  • Maintenance: add translator context, dependency metadata and standardized theme previews. Database schema remains 2.0.

2.8.3-beta1

  • Security: require verified HTTPS for Freemius licensing and protected update downloads; reject insecure fallback and unsafe redirects.
  • Security: update the bundled official Freemius SDK to 2.13.5.
  • Packaging: correct the Free package basename flag and preserve transport protection across Free/Premium load order.
  • Prerelease: controlled acceptance candidate; no database schema change.

2.8.2

  • Fix scoped shortcode click tracking and Freemius licence event invalidation.
  • Fix duplicate lead notifications, webhook transport limits and Turnstile retries.

2.8.1

  • Security: bounded POST validation, card/type checks, click nonce, generic database errors and request limits.
  • Security: server-side Premium gates and stricter lead/consent/Turnstile validation.
  • Fix: name edits preserve profile slugs and printed QR targets; live card preview requires a nonce.
  • Fix: shared frontend services render once across themes and shortcodes.
  • Fix: downgrade edits preserve stored Premium card/settings values.
  • Compatibility: PHP 8.1 minimum; explicit CSV escape parameter for PHP 8.4.
  • Packaging: Freemius Premium-only annotations and deterministic local Free/Premium preflight builds.
  • Data safety: uninstall retains customer data.

2.8.0

  • New: Honeypot spam protection on Lead Capture forms â€” bots are silently rejected, real users see nothing.
  • New: optional Cloudflare Turnstile verification for Premium lead capture forms.
  • New: Security & Spam tab in Settings with Honeypot toggle and Turnstile API key fields (locked for free users with upgrade prompt).
  • New: Analytics overhaul â€” daily CTR grouped bar chart (Phone / Email / Social / VCF), per-card performance table with sortable columns, CSV export, and zero-click warning badges.
  • New: Department-based filtering on the Analytics page.
  • New: data-track click tracking attributes added to all built-in themes (Glass, Default, Cyberpunk, Editorial, Aurora, Brutal, Elite, Kurumsal, Luxury, Minimal, Sade).
  • New: Freemius SDK integration for licensing and premium feature delivery.
  • Improved: All admin strings are now in English (default). Turkish translation bundled as tr_TR.
  • Improved: Companies & Branches settings section is now fully responsive.
  • Fixed: Click analytics card_id was always 0 â€” no clicks were being recorded. The theme context now supplies the card ID.

2.7.0

  • New: per-card QR code generation with PNG/SVG download.
  • New: QR engine abstraction layer with chillerlan/php-qrcode as the default adapter.
  • New: optional frontend QR display on profile pages (Settings toggle).
  • New: QR images are cached in the site’s uploads directory and refreshed when needed.
  • New: a licence helper that identifies the installed edition.
  • Changed: minimum PHP raised from 5.6 to 7.4.

2.6.0

  • New: pretty permalinks (/v/{slug}) with configurable prefix.
  • New: Settings page for permalink, default theme, and download filename.
  • New: theme engine with four built-in themes.
  • New: avatar and logo support via the WordPress media library.
  • New: eight social media platforms.
  • New: per-card theme override.

2.1.0

  • Complete rewrite to object-oriented architecture.
  • New: a dedicated WordPress capability for card management.
  • New: WP_List_Table-based admin UI with search and pagination.
  • New: RFC 2426 compliant escaping and UTF-8 safe line folding.
  • New: full nonce + capability checks on all endpoints.
  • Fixed: nested function name collision causing PHP fatal on second download.
  • Fixed: missing vCard escaping for contacts with commas, semicolons, or multi-line notes.
